title: Constant Radius
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Constant_Radius.md
text: Generate commands for tracking constant radius path, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} sets the start time, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} sets the target velocity, {Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} sets the units, {R}, {Initial longitudinal position, X_o [m]} sets the initial longitudinal start point, {Initial lateral position, Y_o [m]} sets the initial lateral start point, {Initial yaw angle, psi_o [rad]} sets the starting heading angle, {Distance between inside and outside cone boundaries, radialConeDist [m]} sets the radial distance between cones, {Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ayMax [g]} sets the maximum allowable lateral acceleration before simulation, {Maneuver direction, steerDir} sets the maneuver direction, {Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold} sets the option to stop simulation at lateral acceleration and {Instantiate 3D cones (Simulation 3D Scene Configuration required)} sets the option to instantiate 3D cones. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Longitudinal position vehicle center of mass scalar

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Lateral position vehicle center of mass scalar

params.name: R
params.values: Radius to be tracked 100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Distance between inside and outside cone boundaries, radialConeDist [m]
params.values: Radial distance between cones 6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lateral acceleration absolute threshold, ayMax [g]
params.values: Maximum allowable lateral acceleration before simulation is stopped 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold
params.values: Option to stop simulation at lateral acceleration threshold off (default) | on

params.name: Instantiate 3D cones (Simulation 3D Scene Configuration required)
params.values: Option to instantiate 3D cones off (default) | on
